title: Turkey Bacon & White Bean Breakfast Hash
subtitle: A leaner skillet hash built on turkey bacon, white beans, and crisped potatoes.
description: Turkey bacon and white beans fold into a crisped potato hash with peppers and onion, finished with eggs cooked over the top. White beans add fiber and body next to a leaner bacon than the hall's usual pork versions.

steps.title: Par-cook the potatoes
steps.instruction: Microwave diced potatoes with a splash of water in a covered bowl until just tender. This cuts skillet time and helps them crisp instead of steam.

steps.title: Crisp the turkey bacon
steps.instruction: Cook diced turkey bacon in a large skillet or two batches on a griddle over medium-high until browned and crisp at the edges. Remove and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the pan.

steps.title: Crisp the potatoes
steps.instruction: Add olive oil to the pan, then add par-cooked potatoes in a single layer. Let sit 3–4 minutes for color before tossing. Add onion and bell pepper and cook until softened and browned in spots.

steps.title: Fold in bacon and beans
steps.instruction: Return turkey bacon to the pan along with white beans. Toss to combine and warm through.

steps.title: Top with eggs and finish
steps.instruction: Make shallow wells in the hash and crack an egg into each. Cover with a lid or inverted sheet pan over medium-low until egg whites are set and yolks reach preference.

stationWorkflow: Par-cook potatoes in the microwave first to save real skillet time.
Crisp turkey bacon before the potatoes so its rendered fat flavors the hash.
Add eggs last so they finish exactly when the rest of the pan is ready.
cleanupNotes: Deglaze the skillet with hot water while still warm, then scrub once cool enough to handle.
Wipe down cutting boards immediately after raw turkey bacon prep.
leftovers: Reheat the potato-bean base covered at 325°F for 10 minutes; fry fresh eggs rather than reheating set yolks.
